title: Assembly provenance
description: Declares which registered assembly this agreement instantiates — the composition's identity, committed under agreementHash. The designer composes this clause into the assembly; the field fills mechanically at checkout with the template's own compositionHash (it cannot be a designer value: the hash cannot appear inside the composition it hashes). This section is what makes an assembly creditable at all: agreement leaves are keyed by CLAUSE, so a compositionHash is never itself a leaf key — UsageCounter.recordAssemblyUsage proves THIS leaf and matches its content against the assembly claimed. Without this clause in the agreement, no process can credit its designer.

fields.name: compositionHash
fields.description: The AssemblyRegistry compositionHash of the assembly this agreement was instantiated from (bytes32 hex).
